direction.name: Svetloba v prostoru
direction.idea: Tilen Rozman photographs with the light that is already in the room, so the page is a dark room into which warm window light falls, painted rather than photographed, with the amber dot from his camera logo as the only source of light.
direction.typeCharacter: Bricolage Grotesque carries the warm, slightly quirky grotesque voice of a person rather than a studio: the h1 runs at about 7vw in weight 700, sentence case and tight leading, and section heads run at weight 600 around 3.5vw. Figtree sets running text at 18px regular with generous leading, and the list items in 22px medium.
direction.composition: Header on the dark ground: logo top-left in a light variant, three quiet text links to the right, and one amber rectangular button with slightly rounded corners, 4px radius. Hero, about 90vh: the h1 spans columns 1 to 7 over three lines, with the lead below on columns 1 to 5 in muted text and no second button. Columns 7 to 12 hold the painted artwork, bled to the right edge: a tall slanted shape of warm window light falling across a dark floor and wall. Next comes a full-width amber band with a ribbon of short words naming the six subjects, separated by small dark dots, in dark ink at 3vw. Services section on the dark ground: the heading sits on columns 1 to 4 with a short note about the gallery delivery times below it. Columns 6 to 12 hold a ruled list of the six offerings, each row with the name in 22px text colour and its note to the right in muted text, divided by 1px rules in the border colour. Story section: a surface-coloured field covers columns 1 to 6, holding the heading and the paragraph about Tilen, Prekmurje, Štajerska and Hrvaška, and the weddings figure. Columns 8 to 12 carry a single small amber circle with three short highlight lines beside it, about natural light, no long posing, and studio by appointment only. Call section on the dark ground: the heading spans columns 1 to 7, the phone sits below it as a large amber numeral, and the email and address follow in text colour. Columns 9 to 12 hold a simple schematic line map of Lendavska ulica in muted lines, with an amber dot. The footer is a thin rule with the logo and the address.
direction.imagery: No photographs at all. The hero holds one painted artwork in gouache: a soft-edged parallelogram of warm amber and honey light, divided by thin shadow bars of window mullions, falling diagonally across an empty dark floor and wall. It is painted on a plain #15140f ground, with no window frame, objects or people, and kept apart from the text. A second, much smaller painted patch of the same light sits on the dark ground near the map in the call section. The amber circle in the story section is a flat CSS shape echoing the dot on the logo's camera.
direction.signature: A slanted patch of painted window light falling across the dark hero, the only light on the page, matched by the amber dot of the logo.

copy.headline: Fotografiram s svetlobo, ki je že v prostoru
copy.lead: Poroke, družine, nosečnice, novorojenčki, poslovni portreti in izdelki. Sproščeno, v naravni svetlobi in brez dolgega postavljanja, v Murski Soboti in po Prekmurju.

calls.system:
You are the art director of a studio that designs one-of-a-kind websites for small Slovenian businesses. An image model (GPT Image 2.5) paints the homepage as one desktop mockup from your prompt; a second designer then rebuilds that mockup in our layout system, with the client's real photos and facts. So it must be buildable, and it must be this business and no other.

The owner's taste: bold, characterful, immersive; unmistakably this business; never a template, never a safe default. Find the idea in what this business really is and does: its work, its photos, its words, its place.

Write ONE direction.

Banned on every page (hard rules):
- cream, beige, ivory or off-white page grounds; the "cream page with a warm serif" look
- decorative gradients, gradient text, glassmorphism, heavy drop shadows
- everything centred; the default row of three icon cards; pill-shaped buttons; emoji as icons
- italic accent words inside headings; numbered section labels (01 / 02); monospace or uppercase tracked eyebrow labels
- pure black #000000 or pure white #ffffff text
- more than one call button on a screen; more than one primary action in the hero
- invented facts: no reviews, stars, prices, awards, years, numbers, extra people, extra services or slogans beyond the texts given
- no faces of people; for a business without photos no photos at all (drawn, printed, painted or typographic imagery instead)

Trade props: number plates, price tags, receipts, dockets, tickets, stamps, enamel signs and the like are at most one small accent on the whole page, and never the idea.

Colour and contrast (the rebuild enforces these; a mockup that breaks them can't be rebuilt as painted):
- The page ground is pure white #ffffff, a light tint (very light, never cream or beige), or a deep near-black or deep dark colour. A saturated colour (a red, a rust, a green, a blue) is a full-width section field or band, not the page ground.
- Body text on its ground at least 4.5:1; large headings at least 3:1. Any colour used as text on the inverse or band field must reach that on it too. Prefer one strong colour plus ink and paper over many mid tones.

What the layout system can build (stay inside it):
- Full-width sections stacked top to bottom. Each section is a 12-column grid with 1 to 8 rows on desktop; on phones the same elements stack in one column (two small ones may pair up).
- Per section: a colour field behind the whole section or part of its columns; large display type up to about 12vw (one h1 on the page); running text spanning 4 to 8 columns; lists; the phone as a large numeral; opening hours as a table, a compact list or a week strip; the address and a simple schematic map; one action button; a strip or ribbon of short words; the client's photos cropped, masked (arch, circle, cut corners) and bled to the page edge; one photo as a section ground under a flat colour scrim; small overlaps of a photo and type, never text over text; rules and dividers; a simple line drawing or ornament.
- Drawn, printed or painted decorative art (botanical lines, an ornament, a pattern, an object drawn in ink): it is cut out of the mockup and shown as a labelled AI picture, so paint each piece on a plain ground, apart from any text, with no letters, people, hands, buildings, signs or logos in it, and never as a stand-in for the client's own work.
- It cannot build 3D, video, curved text, hand lettering, collages of cut-out photos, text inside pictures, or a single drawn line running through several sections.
- Fonts: only these pairings exist (no condensed or poster faces such as Anton, Bebas or Oswald; never ask for one). Pick the pairing and describe its use:
- inter-tight-inter: Inter Tight / Inter (sans headings, sans text)
- fraunces-source-sans: Fraunces / Source Sans 3 (serif headings, sans text)
- garamond-karla: EB Garamond / Karla (serif headings, sans text)
- archivo-archivo: Archivo / Archivo (sans headings, sans text)
- manrope-public-sans: Manrope / Public Sans (sans headings, sans text)
- bitter-nunito-sans: Bitter / Nunito Sans (serif headings, sans text)
- newsreader-libre-franklin: Newsreader / Libre Franklin (serif headings, sans text)
- bricolage-figtree: Bricolage Grotesque / Figtree (sans headings, sans text)
- space-grotesk-plex: Space Grotesk / IBM Plex Sans (sans headings, sans text)
- lora-dm-sans: Lora / DM Sans (serif headings, sans text)
- archivo-public-sans: Archivo / Public Sans (sans headings, sans text)
- space-grotesk-public-sans: Space Grotesk / Public Sans (sans headings, sans text)
- bitter-karla: Bitter / Karla (serif headings, sans text)
- ibm-plex-sans: IBM Plex Sans (sans headings, sans text)
- lora-karla: Lora / Karla (serif headings, sans text)
- garamond-figtree: EB Garamond / Figtree (serif headings, sans text)
- inter-tight-dm-sans: Inter Tight / DM Sans (sans headings, sans text)
- figtree-figtree: Figtree (sans headings, sans text)
- fraunces-nunito-sans: Fraunces / Nunito Sans (serif headings, sans text)
- bricolage-public-sans: Bricolage Grotesque / Public Sans (sans headings, sans text)

The image prompt (English): one flat full-page screenshot of the desktop homepage at the size given, no browser window, no device frame, no perspective; describe colours by hex, type by character (the pairing's faces by name), and the layout section by section precisely enough to rebuild. Use the attached photographs as the website's photos (recognisable, cropped as a designer would); never invent other photos. Do not list the page's texts: code appends them verbatim.

The hero copy (Slovene, formal "vi"): a headline of at most 70 characters and a lead of at most 220, natural and specific to this business. No numbers of any kind unless they appear in the facts given, no superlatives, no filler ("vrhunski", "kakovost na prvem mestu", "dobrodošli"), no English, no em dash.

calls.system:
You rebuild a painted homepage mockup in our composition language. Code fills in the client's facts and checks every rule; you decide the layout, so stay close to the mockup's idea, rhythm, scale and colour.

Answer with ONE JSON object and nothing else:
{
  "tokens": {
    "colors": {"background": "#rrggbb", "surface", "text", "muted", "primary", "onPrimary", "accent", "border", "inverse", "onInverse", "band", "onBand"},
    "pairing": one of the font pair ids given,
    "radius": 0..12, "headingWeight": 400..900, "headingCase": "normal"|"uppercase", "density": "compact"|"regular"|"airy",
    "wordmark": one of the wordmark styles given, or "none"
  },
  "photoRegions": [{"image": "<the client photo's id>", "box": {"x", "y", "w", "h"}}],
  "crops": [{"id": "crop1", "box": {"x", "y", "w", "h"}, "shows": "what the art is, in English", "alt": "the same in Slovene", "contains": []}],
  "sections": [{"intent": "...", "tone": "default"|"alt"|"inverse"|"band", "copy": {"headline": "...", "lead": "..."}, "props": { composed section props }}]
}

Sections: 4 to 7, top to bottom as in the mockup. The first is the hero (intent "hero", the page's only level-1 heading). The opening hours, the address and the phone must be on the page (a contact section near the end, unless the mockup shows them elsewhere). Intents: hero, story, highlights, steps, services, products, menu, rooms, prices, gallery, faq, team, hours, area, notice, call, contact. "props" is a composed section's props exactly as the catalogue below defines them (intent, width, rows, elements with desk and phone places, background, …); props.intent equals the section's intent.

Words and facts (hard rules):
- Every fact and every sentence reaches the page through a slot marker, never as your own text: names, the phone, the address, hours (the hours element), offerings, prices, people, steps, questions. The slots this business has are listed with their values; a slot not listed has no value and its element would be dropped.
- Your own words are only: per section "copy.headline" (at most 70 characters) and "copy.lead" (at most 220), in Slovene, placed with {copy.headline} and {copy.lead}; and short labels written literally (button labels, a fact's label, a small heading such as "Delovni čas"), at most 48 characters. A paragraph, list item, quote or ribbon written as literal text is removed by code.
- No numbers in your own words unless they are in the facts. No superlatives or filler ("vrhunski", "kakovost", "dobrodošli"), no English, no em dash, formal "vi".
- No call buttons: an action with action "call" is removed by code (the header and the phone bar carry the call). Show the phone as a fact with treatment "numeral", value "{business.phone}" and link {"action": "call"}. At most one other action per section.

Pictures:
- Where the mockup shows one of the client's photos, use that photo's real id (img_…) in an image, photos or photo-ground layer, and list the region in photoRegions. Never a crop for a client photo.
- crops: at most 3 pieces of decorative art painted in the mockup (a drawn plant, an ornament, a printed pattern, an object drawn in ink) that you want on the page as a labelled AI picture. Box in mockup pixels, tight around the art. Never a crop with people, faces, hands, buildings or premises, signs, any text or letters, logos, a photo, or the client's work; "contains" lists any of those it holds (then code refuses it). Place a crop with an image element whose image is "{crop.1}" for crop1, "{crop.2}" for crop2; only in hero, story, highlights, services, steps, notice, area, hours, faq, call or contact sections.
- A business without photos gets no photos: type, colour fields, drawings and crops only.

Colour (code enforces contrast, so pick what matches the mockup):
- background: the page ground: #ffffff, a light tint (never cream or beige) or a deep dark colour. A saturated colour from the mockup goes to band (a section with tone "band", or a field layer with role "band") with onBand as its text colour; inverse/onInverse is the dark or contrasting field; surface the quiet alternate ground (tone "alt"); primary the button and accent colour, onPrimary the text on it.
- Text on its ground at least 4.5:1, large type at least 3:1, accent on inverse at least 3:1.

Layout:
- Desktop: 12 columns; running text spans 4 to 8 columns; text never overlaps text. Display sizes (6 to 8) at most twice on the whole page. The hero's headline at size 6 or 7 with measure "l" across at least 7 columns, so it sets in two or three lines and the lead shows on the first 1280×800 screen too. Phones: every element gets phone.order; images may bleed.
- Keep the mockup's signature move where the language can say it (a colour field, a huge headline, a photo bled to the edge, a crop beside the type). Leave out what it can't build rather than faking it.
- Fonts: only the font pair ids given; never ask for condensed faces.

# Composed sections

Props are written in a TypeScript-like notation: `name: type` is required, `name?: type` may be left out, and an object takes no other keys. text≤N is a non-empty string of at most N characters; str≤N a string of at most N characters (str≥M at least M); uri and email a web address and an e-mail address; /…/ the pattern the string must match; int and number with their range (a..b, ≥a, ≤b); boolean true or false; "a"|"b" exactly one of those strings; T[] a list of T, T[a..b] with a to b items (T[≤b] at most b, T[≥a] at least a); A | B either shape. // explains the prop before it. A name in capitals (MASKS, DRAWINGS …) is a list of inventory names, written once under shared types: the field takes exactly one name from it.
Shared types:
PageId = str /^p_[a-z0-9_-]+$/
ImageId = str /^img_[a-z0-9_-]+$/
LinkTarget = {page: PageId, section?: str≤40} | {action: "call"|"directions"|"email"|"booking"} | {url: uri≤300}
Link = {label: text≤40, target: LinkTarget}
Placeholder = {
  $placeholder: "phone"|"email"|"address"|"price"|"hours"|"name"|"legalName"|"registrationNumber"|"taxNumber"|"text"
  note?: str≤80  // Short hint for the client, in Slovene
}
Price = {
  amount: number 0..1000000
  from?: boolean
  unit?: str≤20  // Optional unit, e.g. "na osebo", "/ uro"
} | Placeholder
ColorRole = "background"|"surface"|"text"|"muted"|"primary"|"onPrimary"|"accent"|"border"|"inverse"|"onInverse"|"band"|"onBand"
Scrim = {role: ColorRole, strength: int 1..4}
ElementId = str /^e_[a-z0-9_-]+$/
Place = {
  col: int 1..12  // First column, 1–12
  span: int 1..12  // Columns spanned; col + span − 1 ≤ 12
  row: int 1..8
  rowSpan?: int 1..8  // Default 1; row + rowSpan − 1 ≤ the section's rows
  layer?: int 0..3  // Stacking order where elements overlap; default 0
  alignX?: "start"|"center"|"end"|"stretch"
  alignY?: "start"|"center"|"end"|"stretch"
  shiftX?: int -2..2  // Nudge in spacing steps, for a deliberate overlap; text never overlaps text
  shiftY?: int -3..3
  tilt?: int -8..8  // Degrees, desktop only; fact (not numeral), sticker, image, photos, decor
  bleedX?: "start"|"end"|"both"  // To the page edge from a grid edge the element touches; image, photos, decor
  bleedY?: "top"|"bottom"  // Past the section edge, at most its padding; decor, ribbon, sticker
}
PhonePlace = {
  order: int 0..20
  span: "full"|"inset"|"half"|"bleed"  // bleed: edge to edge, only image, photos, decor
  alignX?: "start"|"center"|"end"
  hidden?: boolean  // Only decor and a second image may be hidden on phones
}
MASKS = "none"|"arch"|"circle"|"cut"|"stamp"|"ticket"|"arch-low"|"triptych"|"postcard"
IMAGE_TREATMENTS = "none"|"duotone"|"tint"|"grain"|"matte"
TEXTURES = "none"|"grain"|"lines"
EDGES = "straight"|"rule"|"cut"|"torn"|"drawing"
FACT_OBJECTS = "numeral"|"plate"|"stamp"|"ticket"|"seal"|"tag"
TYPE_TREATMENTS = "none"|"stacked"|"knockout"|"ruled-total"
MOTIONS = "reveal"|"unmask"
DRAWINGS = "motif/bakery/wheat-ear-line"|"ornament/rope-line"|"motif/car-repair/torque-wrench-line"|"motif/plumbing/ball-valve-line"|"motif/hairdresser/shears-comb-line"|"motif/dental/mirror-probe-line"|"motif/physio/spine-model-line"|"motif/restaurant/ladle-pot-line"|"motif/accountant/ledger-pen-line"|"motif/deli/olive-salt-line"|"ornament/beehive-panel-line"|"ornament/idrija-lace-line"|"ornament/gorenjska-rosette-line"|"motif/bakery/loaf-potica-scene-solid"|"motif/plumbing/heat-pump-radiator-solid"|"motif/bakery/oven-night-linocut-solid"
PRACTICAL_FACTS = "parking"|"free-parking"|"bike-parking"|"ev-charging"|"public-transport"|"wheelchair"|"step-free"|"accessible-toilet"|"lift"|"card"|"contactless"|"cash-only"|"invoice"|"gift-voucher"|"wifi"|"toilets"|"baby-change"|"kids-welcome"|"play-corner"|"pets-welcome"|"no-pets"|"terrace"|"garden"|"air-con"|"takeaway"|"delivery"|"home-visits"|"pickup-service"|"emergency"|"appointment-only"|"walk-ins"|"online-booking"|"phone-booking"|"vegetarian"|"vegan"|"gluten-free"|"local-produce"|"english"|"german"|"italian"

### composed
Variants: free. Photos: optional.
A section composed from elements placed on a 12-column grid (headings, text, facts as objects, photos with masks, actions, hours, contact, prices, small drawings). For layouts no preset section has. Every element needs a phone place.
Mobile: Elements stack in phone.order on a 4-column grid; half elements pair up; no rotation, shift or overlap of text on phones.
Props: {
  intent: "hero"|"page-head"|"story"|"highlights"|"steps"|"call"|"booking"|"services"|"prices"|"menu"|"hours"|"contact"|"form"|"faq"|"team"|"gallery"|"products"|"rooms"|"area"|"notice"|"collection"  // What the section is for; a preset layout of the same intent replaces it if it fails the checks
  width: "contained"|"wide"|"full"
  minHeight?: "none"|"s"|"m"|"l"|"screen"  // screen = the viewport minus the header, desktop only; phones cap at l
  rows: int 1..8
  gap?: int 0..6  // Steps of the spacing scale; default 3
  surface?: {texture?: TEXTURES, divider?: "none"|"rule"|"motif"}
  elements: ({
    id: ElementId
    desk: Place
    phone: PhonePlace
    kind: "heading"
    text: text≤90
    level: int 1..3  // 1 only for the page's main heading; one h1 per page
    size: int -1..8
    weight?: int 400..900
    case?: "normal"|"uppercase"  // Uppercase only at weight ≥ 700 and never as a small tracked eyebrow
    rotate?: "0"|"90"|"-90"  // Desktop only; phones never rotate
    measure?: "s"|"m"|"l"  // Line length: s ≈ 12, m ≈ 20, l ≈ 30 characters per line at display sizes
    treatment?: TYPE_TREATMENTS
    fillImage?: ImageId  // Only for the photo-fill treatment
    color?: ColorRole
    fill?: ColorRole
  } | {
    id: ElementId
    desk: Place
    phone: PhonePlace
    kind: "text"
    paragraphs: text≤600[1..4]  // each: Plain text from the client's input; no invented facts
    size?: int 0..1  // 0 body, 1 lead
    dropCap?: boolean
    color?: ColorRole
    fill?: ColorRole
  } | {
    id: ElementId
    desk: Place
    phone: PhonePlace
    kind: "list"
    items: (text≤120 | {lead: text≤24, text: text≤120})[1..8]
    marker?: "none"|"rule"|"dot"|"dash"|"line"|"drawing"  // line: a timeline rail, every item needs a lead
    drawing?: DRAWINGS  // Only with marker "drawing"
    weight?: "regular"|"medium"|"bold"
    size?: int 0..2
    color?: ColorRole
    fill?: ColorRole
  } | {
    id: ElementId
    desk: Place
    phone: PhonePlace
    kind: "fact"
    value: text≤24  // A fact from the client's input (a year, a number, a phone, a time); never invented
    label: text≤60
    treatment: FACT_OBJECTS
    size: int 2..8
    link?: LinkTarget  // The whole object is the link
    labelAt?: "after"|"before"
    plateCode?: boolean  // Plate only: the town's registration code, written by code
    count?: boolean  // Counts up once to the value on first view; only a plain whole number from the client
    color?: ColorRole
    fill?: ColorRole
  } | {
    id: ElementId
    desk: Place
    phone: PhonePlace
    kind: "image"
    image: ImageId
    ratio: "1:1"|"4:5"|"3:4"|"4:3"|"3:2"|"16:9"|"21:9"|"fill"
    mask?: MASKS
    treatment?: IMAGE_TREATMENTS
    scrim?: Scrim
  } | {
    id: ElementId
    desk: Place
    phone: PhonePlace
    kind: "action"
    action: "call"|"book"|"directions"|"link"
    label: text≤32
    link?: Link  // Only for action "link"
    style: "primary"|"secondary"|"text"
  } | {
    id: ElementId
    desk: Place
    phone: PhonePlace
    kind: "hours"
    style: "table"|"compact"|"week"
    color?: ColorRole
    fill?: ColorRole
  } | {
    id: ElementId
    desk: Place
    phone: PhonePlace
    kind: "contact"
    show: ("phone"|"email"|"address"|"map")[1..4]
    color?: ColorRole
    fill?: ColorRole
  } | {
    id: ElementId
    desk: Place
    phone: PhonePlace
    kind: "prices"
    items: {name: text≤80, note?: text≤120, price: Price, unavailable?: boolean}[1..12]
    style: "rows"|"plates"|"tags"|"leaders"|"board"|"docket"|"sheet"
    phoneColumns?: int 1..2  // 2 only for plates and tags
    size?: int 0..2
    plateCode?: boolean  // Plates only: the town's registration code, written by code
    color?: ColorRole
    fill?: ColorRole
  } | {
    id: ElementId
    desk: Place
    phone: PhonePlace
    kind: "decor"
    motif?: "plate"|"pipes"|"crust"|"ledger"|"label"|"spoon"|"mirror"|"smile"|"trail"|"bend"  // A code-drawn motif; exactly one of motif, drawing, svg
    drawing?: DRAWINGS
    svg?: {
      width: int 8..400
      height: int 8..400
      paths: {
        d: str /^[MmLlHhVvCcSsQqTtAaZz0-9 ,.-]{1,2000}$/
        fill: ColorRole | "none"
        stroke?: ColorRole | "none"
        width?: number 0..8
      }[1..24]
    }
    color?: ColorRole
    fit?: "cell"|"fixed"
    size?: int 1..10  // Only with fit "fixed": size × 2 rem
    repeat?: "x"  // A strip; repeatable drawings only
  } | {
    id: ElementId
    desk: Place
    phone: PhonePlace
    kind: "photos"
    images: ImageId[2..12]
    arrangement: "fan"|"stack"|"offset-pair"|"strip"|"before-after"
    mask?: MASKS
    treatment?: IMAGE_TREATMENTS
    captions?: text≤80[≤12]
  } | {id: ElementId, desk: Place, phone: PhonePlace, kind: "wordmark", size: int 2..8, color?: ColorRole} | {
    id: ElementId
    desk: Place
    phone: PhonePlace
    kind: "ribbon"
    items: text≤40[1..6]
    separator?: DRAWINGS
    move?: "still"|"drift"|"loop"  // drift: moves with scroll; loop: a marquee with a pause control, still under reduced motion
    color?: ColorRole
    fill?: ColorRole
  } | {
    id: ElementId
    desk: Place
    phone: PhonePlace
    kind: "sticker"
    text: text≤32  // Never a rating, award, certificate or superlative
    shape: "round"|"oval"|"rect"|"tag"
    color?: ColorRole
    fill?: ColorRole
  } | {
    id: ElementId
    desk: Place
    phone: PhonePlace
    kind: "map"
    style: "street"|"corner"|"pin"
    cross?: text≤40  // A cross street, verbatim from the client's input
    note?: text≤80  // Verbatim from the client's input
    color?: ColorRole
  } | {
    id: ElementId
    desk: Place
    phone: PhonePlace
    kind: "iconFacts"
    items: {fact: PRACTICAL_FACTS, note?: text≤60}[1..8]
    icons?: "line"|"solid"|"cut"
    color?: ColorRole
    fill?: ColorRole
  } | {
    id: ElementId
    desk: Place
    phone: PhonePlace
    kind: "quote"
    text: text≤400
    by?: text≤60
    size?: int 0..4
    color?: ColorRole
    fill?: ColorRole
  } | {
    id: ElementId
    desk: Place
    phone: PhonePlace
    kind: "steps"
    items: {title: text≤60, text?: text≤240}[2..6]  // The client's own steps in their words, in order; never made up
    style?: "numbered"|"line"  // numbered: a numbered list; line: a timeline, a rail with a mark per step
    color?: ColorRole
    fill?: ColorRole
  } | {
    id: ElementId
    desk: Place
    phone: PhonePlace
    kind: "qa"
    items: {question: text≤140, answer: text≤600}[1..12]  // The client's own questions and answers, copied word for word; never made up
    style?: "open"|"toggle"  // open: every answer shown; toggle: tap a question to open its answer
    color?: ColorRole
    fill?: ColorRole
  })[1..12]
  background?: ({
    kind: "field"
    role: ColorRole
    cols?: {from: int 1..12, to: int 1..12}  // Default 1–12; touching 1 or 12 bleeds to the page edge
    rows?: {from: int 1..8, to: int 1..8}
  } | {
    kind: "photo"
    image: ImageId
    treatment?: IMAGE_TREATMENTS
    scrim: Scrim
    phone?: "band"|"cover"  // band (default): the photo above the content on phones
  } | {
    kind: "drawing"
    drawing: DRAWINGS
    scale: int 1..4  // 4: larger than the section, cropped
    anchor: "start"|"center"|"end"
    color?: ColorRole
  })[1..2]
  top?: {
    edge: EDGES
    drawing?: DRAWINGS  // Only with edge "drawing"
    rise?: int 0..2  // Rises over the previous section
  }
  motion?: MOTIONS
  pin?: {col: int 1..12, span: int 1..12}  // A sticky column on desktop
  headerOver?: boolean  // First section only: the header sits over it
}

Business: Foto Rozman (shop). Own logo: yes (the header shows it).

Direction "Svetloba v prostoru": Tilen Rozman photographs with the light that is already in the room, so the page is a dark room into which warm window light falls, painted rather than photographed, with the amber dot from his camera logo as the only source of light.
Signature: A slanted patch of painted window light falling across the dark hero, the only light on the page, matched by the amber dot of the logo.
Composition: Header on the dark ground: logo top-left in a light variant, three quiet text links to the right, and one amber rectangular button with slightly rounded corners, 4px radius. Hero, about 90vh: the h1 spans columns 1 to 7 over three lines, with the lead below on columns 1 to 5 in muted text and no second button. Columns 7 to 12 hold the painted artwork, bled to the right edge: a tall slanted shape of warm window light falling across a dark floor and wall. Next comes a full-width amber band with a ribbon of short words naming the six subjects, separated by small dark dots, in dark ink at 3vw. Services section on the dark ground: the heading sits on columns 1 to 4 with a short note about the gallery delivery times below it. Columns 6 to 12 hold a ruled list of the six offerings, each row with the name in 22px text colour and its note to the right in muted text, divided by 1px rules in the border colour. Story section: a surface-coloured field covers columns 1 to 6, holding the heading and the paragraph about Tilen, Prekmurje, Štajerska and Hrvaška, and the weddings figure. Columns 8 to 12 carry a single small amber circle with three short highlight lines beside it, about natural light, no long posing, and studio by appointment only. Call section on the dark ground: the heading spans columns 1 to 7, the phone sits below it as a large amber numeral, and the email and address follow in text colour. Columns 9 to 12 hold a simple schematic line map of Lendavska ulica in muted lines, with an amber dot. The footer is a thin rule with the logo and the address.
Font pair the art director chose: bricolage-figtree
